children: Fox Factory Holding Corp. completed the $225M sale of Marucci to Squared Up Holdings, receiving $200M cash at closing and a $25M unsecured subordinated convertible note due Dec. 31, 2026; the $200M cash was used to reduce borrowings.

Net leverage ~2.7x vs 3.7x (pro forma)

Further interest cut to ~$17M w/ $25M

This is a late-stage confirmation of a strategic review begun in February 2026 to exit Marucci and refocus on core performance products. A larger catalyst would be updated guidance showing margin/cash flow uplift from lower interest and reinvestment, plus clarity on the $25M note receipt.
